name: Cycling
description: Cycling word search puzzles gather bike and road English for adults and seniors — pedal, gear, lane, helmet, cadence, climb and calm ride words — without bike-maker brands or race-team names. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and grown-up: chain, brake, bottle, draft and descent vocabulary lifelong riders already use. This hub pairs well with Sports and Hiking when you want a longer outdoor-movement session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a quiet neighborhood loop.
